main_text.p: das Martii quo die Gisela Imperatoris Conra-di Salingui Conjux Lotharii Regis Franciæ Filia nupta prius Brunoni Marozoni Saxoniæ, deinde Ernsteo Duci Sueciorum pie mortem obiit.
Regiæ Serenitatis V. Officiose observantis. Consl. & Senatores Magdeburgenses.
main_text.head: XLII.

p.i: Ad propositā jussu & voluntate Illustrissimi & Potentissimi Principis & Domini, Domini Henrici Regis Navarrœi & Principis Bearniæ, Generosi & Nobilissimi Domini Jacobi Segurii Pardiliani suæ Majestatis Domui. Præfecti, & interioris Consilii Consiliarii primi & Legati, Responsum Amplissimi Senatus Reipublicæ Lubecensis.

page.notes: The heading block is in a large italic display type; the initial R is a large woodcut letter. The first line of the last paragraph is partly in larger italic type. Some words in the display heading are uncertain, notably "Navarreæi" and "Regiam" which may be misread; the last line is cut off at the foot of the page.
